keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Sint Maarten row. One grid cell (253 km2, the grid minimum) for the Dutch part, which the infobox gives as 34 km2 (ratio 7.4: the grid, not the page, is coarse). The cell may also touch the French cell of Saint Martin.

ledger.note: 10 October 2010: Sint Maarten becomes a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. 'On 10 October 2010 Sint Maarten became a constituent country' (Sint Maarten page); it 'encompasses the southern 44% of the divided island of Saint Martin'; the Dissolution page: 'The transition took place at midnight (00:00)' and Curaçao and Sint Maarten 'became two new landen'. The page dates the island territory of the Antilles from 1983 (five island territories after 1986). The netherlands-antilles ledger 18 records the loss.

certainty.note: An island shared with France: the Treaty of Concordia line of 1648 divides it; the dossier's one cell covers the Dutch south.

notes: Written by n-mod from three pages. TYPE: colony of netherlands (constituent country, not sovereign); see aruba's notes. END 2026 = alive today; no dissolve.
